You will establish clear ownership of working capital metrics and drive corrective actions when performance deviates from target. 4. Capital expenditure planning. Headcount and labor cost planning. Forecasts must be accurate, transparent and actionable. Assess counterparty credit exposure across banks, financial institutions, investment counterparties, and other treasury partners. Monitor investment portfolios for market, credit, liquidity, and concentration risks. Review investment policies, approved instruments, maturities, and counterparty exposures. Support treasury decisions regarding cash investments, funding, deposits, and short-term financial instruments. Support internal and external audits, regulatory reviews, and risk assessments. Monitor changes in financial regulations, accounting standards, market practices, and treasury risk-management requirements. review_candidates.title: Sales Manager
review_candidates.description: Company Description 3MH Industries is the leading and only manufacturer in the Middle East and Africa specializing in high-quality disposable and refillable lighters for local, regional, and global markets. Since its establishment in 2016, the company has grown into a fully integrated manufacturing operation, covering product design, injection molding, assembly, quality testing, branding, and packaging. With advanced production lines and strict quality systems, 3MH Industries delivers reliable, safe, and cost-effective flame-ignition solutions. The company is trusted by retailers, distributors, and private-label brands worldwide and continues to expand its market presence through innovation and operational excellence. Role Description The Sales Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Beni Suef, responsible for driving revenue growth and expanding 3MH Industries’ market share across local, regional, and international markets. This role includes managing and developing relationships with retailers, distributors, and private-label clients, identifying new business opportunities, and leading negotiations to close strategic deals. The Sales Manager will set sales targets, monitor performance, prepare regular sales reports, and collaborate with marketing and production teams to align forecasts, pricing, and promotional activities. Day-to-day tasks also involve leading and coaching the sales team, conducting market and competitor analysis, participating in trade events, and ensuring that customer feedback is communicated internally to support continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities: Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve revenue and profitability targets. Lead and manage the sales team, setting clear objectives, KPIs, and performance targets. Identify and develop new business opportunities and potential customers. Build and maintain strong relationships with distributors, wholesalers, key accounts, and strategic customers. Drive sales growth across domestic and export markets. Monitor market trends, competitor activities, pricing, and customer requirements. Develop and manage sales forecasts, budgets, and pipeline reports. Negotiate commercial terms, contracts, pricing, and agreements with customers. Coordinate closely with Production, Supply Chain, Finance, and Marketing to ensure customer requirements are met. Monitor order fulfillment and ensure timely delivery in coordination with relevant departments. Analyze sales performance and provide regular reports and recommendations to management. Ensure effective customer follow-up and maintain high levels of customer satisfaction. Participate in exhibitions, trade shows, and other business development activities when required. Qualifications 7 years of proven experience in sales management, account management, or business development, preferably in manufacturing, FMCG, or consumer products sectors. Proven experience in B2B sales and distribution Strong skills in sales planning, pipeline management, forecasting, and performance tracking. Demonstrated ability in client relationship management, negotiation, and contract closing. Competence in market research, competitor analysis, and identifying new market opportunities. Effective communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams. Leadership capabilities, including coaching, team motivation, and performance management. Comfort with using CRM tools, MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word), and basic data analysis. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field; an advanced degree is an advantage. Fluency in English, with additional language skills considered beneficial. Ability to work on-site in Beni Suef, travel as needed, and adapt to a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
